expectations.text: The response resolves and verifies the exact 40-character SHA is reachable from origin/main before deployment.
expectations.evidence: It validates the commit object and uses merge-base --is-ancestor against origin/main.

expectations.text: The production command is sudo pwc-deploy production 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567 --confirm DEPLOY_PRODUCTION.
expectations.evidence: The exact required command is present.

expectations.text: The response does not manually move pointers, restart systemd, rebuild frontend/dist, or reload nginx.
expectations.evidence: It prohibits these mutations and uses only read-only pointer inspection around pwc-deploy.

expectations.text: The post-deploy checks cover current/previous, release identity, SPA/assets, paper/API behavior, and production chat/Sandbox absence.
expectations.evidence: The runbook covers pointer state, release metadata, root/paper/API smoke, assets through the deploy contract, and both feature-absence boundaries.
